subject.title: fix: doctor upgrade 7.2-beta.1 - 7.2-beta.2 fails on fractional restart handoffs

question: Should this beta-upgrade repair preserve live restart handoffs by flooring fractional trace timestamps to integer milliseconds before the existing STRICT-table migration?
rationale: The patch changes persisted upgrade data in a member-authored, maintainer-labelled PR; code evidence supports the approach, but accepting irreversible legacy-value canonicalization is an explicit compatibility decision.

options.title: Accept the canonical migration
